authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8249 explicitly records the -la forms L. pūchal, Awankari puchul and Hindi pū̃chlā tail. The survey pucul/pūcal forms match that documented extension; vowel length, aspiration and retroflex-l notation remain qualified. No separate -la parent exists in the canonical nodes inspected, so the documented base node is used; local IA transmission is unresolved. Exact response: pūcal.
